source.title: Timemore knowledge base: why would the burrs contact?
source.notes: Honest Coffee Guide lists 5–10, but Timemore forbids 1–6 clicks. Reviewers find one usable click near 8 (7 chokes, 9 runs fast). 83 µm per click is too coarse a step for espresso dialing.

source.title: Honest Coffee Guide: Timemore C3S Pro grind settings

procedure.en: Turn the adjustment dial clockwise until it stops. That is zero. Count clicks counter-clockwise from there.
procedure.pt-BR: Gire o ajuste no sentido horário até travar. Esse é o zero. Conte os cliques no sentido anti-horário a partir dali.

notes: 83 µm per click is burr travel (12 clicks × 83 µm = 1 mm thread pitch), not particle size. The Pro adds a folding handle; burrs, thread and clicks are the same as C3S and C3. About 36 clicks total.
